content.short: Nordstern is a DEX aggregator API returning simulated, zero-fee swap routes across EVM chains.
content.description: Nordstern exposes swap routing as an API rather than a front end, returning routes that have been simulated before they are returned so the caller knows what execution to expect. Simulating first matters for integrators, because a route that looks optimal on paper can revert or slip once it touches real pool state.
content.meta: Swap routing as an API, returning routes already simulated against live pool state.
